description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Notice calling for claims to property of intestate in Homagama   - Cad. Map No. 520006 and other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, specifically calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals without wills. It involves land parcels, cadastral maps, and property registration under the Registration of Title Act, making it clearly a land-related matter falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
